title: Bloodrank
summary: Bloodrank is a spell used by members of the Blood Spiral Brotherhood. This spell allows the user to sacrifice one or more Titans on their side in order to give their energy to power up a different Titan.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: This spell was used in the [[Castle of Vlad Dracul]] by [[Harrison Fears]] to power up his [[Antedeluvian|Powerbonded Antedeluvian]] by sacrificing two [[Marauder]] Titans. This then enabled him to single-handedly take on [[Sabriel|Powerbonded Sabriel]], [[Kaioh the Tracker]], [[Cherit]], [[Lok Lambert]] and the [[Willblade]]. {{source|Lok's Leadership}}

full_text:
Bloodrank is a spell used by members of the Blood Spiral Brotherhood. This spell allows the user to sacrifice one or more Titans on their side in order to give their energy to power up a different Titan.

History

This spell was used in the Castle of Vlad Dracul by Harrison Fears to power up his Powerbonded Antedeluvian by sacrificing two Marauder Titans. This then enabled him to single-handedly take on Powerbonded Sabriel, Kaioh the Tracker, Cherit, Lok Lambert and the Willblade. [Lok's Leadership]

This then enabled him to single-handedly take on [[Sabriel|Powerbonded Sabriel]], [[Kaioh the Tracker]], [[Cherit]], [[Lok Lambert]] and the [[Willblade]]. {{source|Lok's Leadership}}
